summary: Dime Commercial Bancshares filed an 8-K disclosing an October 19, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger under which ES Bancshares (parent of Empire State Bank) will merge into Dime, followed by the bank subsidiary merger into Dime Commercial Bank. Consideration is a mixed cash/stock election: $30.0 million aggregate cash pool funded at $30.0M divided by half the outstanding ES shares, with the balance in Dime stock at an Exchange Ratio. Both boards unanimously approved. Terms beyond the cash pool—exchange ratio value, premium, and close date—are absent from the excerpt. Watch regulatory approvals, election proration, and shareholder votes.
